ideas.title: Long GLD against short SLV into the August payroll print
ideas.thesis: Fixture thesis. The metals pair splits on payroll days because silver carries the industrial beta and gold carries the rates beta, and the market prices them as one trade.

evidence.summary: Fixture numbers: GLD minus SLV over the five sessions after an August payroll print.
evidence.control: the same five-day window on all non-payroll weeks
evidence.era_note: present pre and post 2018, weaker in 2013-2015

ideas.survived: Fixture: the effect could have been a gold-only move, but the silver leg carries half the spread on its own.
ideas.what_kills_it: Fixture: a dollar breakout that lifts both metals together.
ideas.overlap: None. The book holds no metals position and no seasonal ticket in either name.

ideas.title: Utilities pullback buy while the sector rank stays extended
ideas.thesis: Fixture thesis. A one-day flush in a sector whose 63-day rank is still top quartile is a rotation pause, not a trend break.

evidence.summary: Fixture numbers: XLU one-day drops of more than one ATR while rank63 is above 75.
evidence.control: all XLU one-day drops of the same size regardless of rank

ideas.survived: Fixture: the cell survives dropping the two best episodes.
ideas.what_kills_it: Fixture: a rates spike that breaks the sector's rank.
ideas.overlap: Partial. Weak Close Decent Sznls can fire on XLU, though not on this filter.

ideas.title: Dollar futures long into the post-payroll drift
ideas.thesis: Fixture thesis. The dollar drifts up for a few sessions after an August payroll print in this cycle year, and the ETF wrapper cannot pay for the move.

evidence.summary: Fixture numbers: DX index four-day drift after August payrolls in midterm years.
evidence.control: all four-day DX windows in August
evidence.era_note: six observations, one cycle cell, context only

ideas.survived: Fixture: it holds when the weakest observation is dropped, but N is too small to lean on.
ideas.what_kills_it: Fixture: a soft print that sends the dollar down on day one.
